lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a pair of special meetings on Tuesday, September 30th, both centered on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave — HARC takes up the preliminary architecture review for the proposed new buildings, while Town Council hears an appeal of the lot consolidation that has to clear before any of it can move forward. Meanwhile, the County commissioners are workshopping a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee, and the town kicks off its 2027 budget work session on Thursday. Somewhere in between, the San Miguel River Cleanup on Saturday and the watershed restoration talk at the Sherbino on Tuesday are worth your time.

notable.stake: HARC votes on preliminary architecture for all Carhenge building clusters.
Council decides appeal that controls whether Carhenge redevelopment can proceed.
Commissioners workshop a new employee housing impact fee affecting county development.
Final architecture review for 15 employee apartments and 4 new multifamily units.
2027 General Fund and Capital Fund contours set before formal budget adoption begins.
